headline: Best World Global CEO Dora Hoan Named Chair of World Federation of Direct Selling
summary: Best World International global CEO Dora Hoan has been appointed to chair the global direct selling body, becoming the first Asia-Pacific leader in the organization's 48-year history.
why: Best World International is a Singapore-listed consumer product and direct-selling distributor operating in regional markets.

impacts.name: Best World International
impacts.why: Chairmanship of the global trade body raises executive and brand prominence across international direct selling markets.
